rows.Benefits Description.Organ/tissue transp: All transplants and related services within this section, Preauthorization is required. See Section 3, Other services that require preauthorization . These solid organ and tissue transplants are covered and limited to: • Allogeneic islet • Autologous pancreas islet cell transplant (as an adjunct to total or near total pancreatectomy) only for patients with chronic pancreatitis • Cornea • Heart • Heart/Lung • Intestinal transplants - Isolated small intestine - Small intestine with the liver - Small intestine with multiple organs, such as the liver, stomach, and pancreas • Kidney • Kidney/Pancreas

rows.Benefits Description.Organ/tissue transp: Blood or marrow stem cell transplants: The Plan extends coverage for the diagnoses as indicated below. For the diagnoses listed below, the medical necessity limitation is considered satisfied if the patient meets the staging description. • Allogeneic transplants for: - Acute lymphocytic or non-lymphocytic (i.e., myelogenous) leukemia - Acute myeloid leukemia - Advanced Hodgkin's lymphoma with recurrence (relapsed) - Advanced Myeloproliferative Disorders (MPDs) - Advanced neuroblastoma
